exposure: Presence or absence of sternocleidomastoid (SCM) lesion as determined by ultrasonography
outcome: Passive range of motion of the neck
cohort: The study included 182 patients diagnosed with congenital muscular torticollis (CMT).
finding: Patients with congenital muscular torticollis (CMT) without SCM lesions exhibited better prognoses, shorter treatment durations, and distinct patterns of head tilting and rotation compared to those with SCM lesions.
